{"name": "run_python", "parameters": {"code": "import csv
catalog_csv_paths = [\"../data/CATALOG_CSV\']
with open(catalog_csv_paths[0], \"r\") as f:
    reader = csv.DictReader(f)
    timeseries_id_wh = next((r[\"timeseries_id\"] for r in reader if r[\"point_class\"] == \"whole building electric\"), None)

with open(catalog_csv_paths[0], \"r\") as f:
    reader = csv.DictReader(f)
    rows_wh = [int(row[\"value\"]) for row in csv.DictReader(f) if row[\"timeseries_id\"] == timeseries_id_wh and str(row[\"timestamp\"])[:10] == \"2018-04-26\"]

values_csv_path = \"../data/VALUES_CSV\"
with open(values_csv_path, \"r\") as f:
    reader = csv.DictReader(f)
    rows_wh_diff = [int(row[\"value\"])-rows_wh[-1] for row in csv.DictReader(f) if row[\"timeseries_id\"] == timeseries_id_wh and str(row[\"timestamp\"])[:10] == \"2018-04-24\"]

if not rows_wh_diff:
    print(0)
fh=open("/tmp/tmp.txt",\"w\")
fh.write(str(sum((int(i) for i in rows_wh_diff))))
fh.close()
"}}
